sample_posts.text:
Stablecoins Are Not Financial Inclusion Until They Can Extend Credit
> We have mostly solved how money moves. We have not solved who gets access to capital.
> Giving someone access to credit allows them to build.
> Stablecoins will only reach their full potential in emerging markets when they become connected to a credible credit layer: one that combines productive accounts, local underwriting, regulated lending, business operating data, guarantees and institutional capital.
Source:

tweet.text:
the next stablecoin killer product isn’t another card or wallet: it’s credit,

but overcollateralized lending isn’t financial inclusion. it asks emerging-market borrowers to already own the capital they need.

my thesis on the missing credit layer ↓ https://x.com/i/article/2092246719530446848
